tbesh_html:
: vain/empty/worthless
1) emptiness, vanity, falsehood
1a) emptiness, nothingness, vanity
1b) emptiness of speech, lying
1c) worthlessness (of conduct)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
strongs_1890.derivation: or שַׁו; from the same as H7722 (שׁוֹא) in the sense of desolating;
